headline: One In, One Out, Nobody Home
deck: A dead-quiet window: only test1 moved, one in and one out, with Kjell Scherpen dropped and unclaimed.
body:
One deal. That is the whole of gameweek 5's business, and it belonged to test1 alone: one in, one out, a straight swap and back to the sofa. The rest of the league sat on its hands and watched.

No churn to report because there was nothing to churn. When a single manager makes the only move on the page, the trend writes itself, and the trend is silence.

Kjell Scherpen departs the wire without a farewell. Signed in hope, dropped without ceremony, survived by a bench spot that will not be kept warm. He waits now among the unclaimed, a goalkeeper nobody is in a hurry to trust.

quiz.q: How many deals went through in gameweek 5?
Which manager made the only move?
What was the shape of test1's business?
Which goalkeeper was dropped and left unclaimed?
